22	/**
23	 * Counts how many existing owners live in a given city, compared case-insensitively. The
24	 * comparison is done in memory because the stored cities are not kept in a normalized form,
25	 * mirroring {@link NamesakeCounter}. Used to drive the per-city sequence of an owner's
26	 * {@link CustomerCodeGenerator customer code}.
27	 */
28	@Component
29	public class CityOwnerCounter {
30	
31	    private final ClinicService clinicService;
32	
33	    public CityOwnerCounter(ClinicService clinicService) {
34	        this.clinicService = clinicService;
35	    }
36	
37	    /**
38	     * Counts the existing owners whose city matches the given one, case-insensitively.
39	     *
40	     * @param city the city of the owner being created
41	     * @return the number of existing owners in that city
42	     */
43	    public long count(String city) {
44	        return this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
45	            .filter(existing -> existing.getCity() != null && existing.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(city))
46	            .count();
47	    }
48	}

19	import java.time.LocalDate;
20	
21	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
22	
23	/**
24	 * Decides whether the "bulk signup" warning applies: it does once more than
25	 * {@value #BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD} owners have already been registered on a single day.
26	 * The owners registered on the day are counted by their registration date via
27	 * {@link DailyRegistrationCounter}, the same accumulation path used to enforce the per-day cap in
28	 * {@link DailyRegistrationCapacityValidator}.
29	 */
30	@Component
31	public class BulkSignupWarningEvaluator {
32	
33	    /** The number of owners a day must exceed before the bulk-signup warning is raised. */
34	    public static final long BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 80;
35	
36	    private final DailyRegistrationCounter dailyRegistrationCounter;
37	
38	    public BulkSignupWarningEvaluator(DailyRegistrationCounter dailyRegistrationCounter) {
39	        this.dailyRegistrationCounter = dailyRegistrationCounter;
40	    }
41	
42	    /**
43	     * @return {@code true} when more than {@value #BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD} owners have already
44	     * been registered today.
45	     */
46	    public boolean isWarranted() {
47	        return isWarranted(LocalDate.now());
48	    }
49	
50	    /**
51	     * @param day the day to evaluate registrations for
52	     * @return {@code true} when more than {@value #BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD} owners have already
53	     * been registered on the given day.
54	     */
55	    public boolean isWarranted(LocalDate day) {
56	        return this.dailyRegistrationCounter.count(day) > BULK_SIGNUP_WARNING_THRESHOLD;
57	    }
58	}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, such as 'MR', 'MRS',
            'MS' or 'DR'. When present it is combined with the last name to form
            the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility with the flat form; when the structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied it takes precedence and this value is
            composed from the normalized address lines. On response it holds
            the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; the composed
            'address' is derived from it (and 'addressLine2' when supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present its normalized value is appended to
